method: Standard release, sparse-cells, view-ports and storage-metrics, one excluded warm-up per arm and case, then three fresh processes per arm in alternating order. CLI includes load and export. RSS is the process high-water through inference in bytes. Audit process checked every frozen digest.

heldout_pgo.method: Opposite-workload training, native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit. One warm-up (i=0), four alternating measured pairs. Timing builds check schedule and final graph. The separate audit builds check RHS, writes and Spine.
